directive: Run the scrutiny panel: three parallel reviewers (completeness, justification, intent). Every finding a seat returns carries severity: blocking or severity: advisory. Record the round with panel-scope.sh --record scrutiny, then tick koto with nothing submitted: the scrutiny_verdict gate reads the verdict ledger, exit 0 advances to review, exit 1 (a seat is blocking) waits for scrutiny_outcome, exit 2 holds until the round is recorded.
